name: Intelligent Payment Routing
tagline: Route payment streams safely across changing fees, outages, and hidden test cases.
narrative:
Welcome to YamusaPay's Payments Engineering interview track!

Your task is to design an intelligent payment routing system. Transactions arrive with different values, types (consumer, business, refund, international), and deadlines. Meanwhile, providers vary in fees, capacity, latency, and reliability.

The visible stream teaches the contract. When you click Submit, your routing system is evaluated against hidden server-side test scenarios with unseen outages and fee changes!
objective: Process the visible stream without timeouts, protect urgent payments, and pass all hidden test scenarios.
learningObjective: Combine eligibility, capacity, reliability, urgency, cost, and retry history into one general routing system.
intelligenceExplanation:
Start with an empty rule set. Build decision branches:
1. Filter out ineligible or offline providers using `canRouteA`, `canRouteB`, `canRouteC`.
2. Reserve reliable, low-latency routes for urgent or high-value payments.
3. Balance routine traffic across fees, latency, and remaining capacity.
hint: Check provider eligibility first using canRouteA/B/C before evaluating fees or latency.
hints: Separate eligibility from preference: use canRouteA/B/C before comparing fees.
Direct urgent or high-value payments to fast, reliable routes.
Avoid immediately resubmitting a retried payment to the same failing provider.
brief: Route payment streams safely through changing provider conditions and pass hidden test scenarios.
context: Each tick processes one payment while providers execute earlier payments in parallel.

steps.label: Filter out unavailable, incompatible, or capacity-exhausted providers
